metadata.title: HookLens — Product story
metadata.description: Annotate addictive design on app screenshots and generate an Addiction Report. Not Screen Time. Not a blocker.

hero.title: A name tag on the trap
hero.description:
HookLens helps you mark addictive UI on screenshots — infinite scroll, badges, autoplay, rabbit holes — then ships a readable report.
Not Screen Time. Not a blocker.

introduce.title: Labels on the trap
introduce.label: Product
introduce.description: Turn “this app is addictive” into boxes and notes you can show someone in under two minutes.

items.title: Screenshot workspace
items.description: Upload a capture or pick a wireframe sample — no extension required for the demo.

items.title: Shared hook dictionary
items.description: The same types as Patterns: infinite scroll, badges, related chrome, autoplay.

items.title: Addiction Report
items.description: Summary, marked image, and findings — then links to Patterns and cleaner Apps.

benefits.title: Why not Screen Time?
benefits.label: Difference
benefits.description: Blockers cut access. HookLens names the machinery so people can choose — and later find products that ship without those hooks.

items.title: Name the mechanism
items.description: Language you can show a friend: variable reward, endless feed, badge anxiety — not just a timer.

items.title: Browser-first demo
items.description: Judge or friend opens the site, analyzes a screenshot, and reads the report — no install step.

items.title: Path to cleaner apps
items.description: After the report, browse an illustrative directory of alternatives that drop the worst hooks.

usage.title: Product flow
usage.description: The story this site tells end-to-end.

items.title: Choose a screenshot
items.description: Wireframe sample or your own PNG/JPG.

items.title: Annotate hooks
items.description: Drag boxes, pick types, write why it pulls you back.

items.title: Generate Report
items.description: Share the “oh that's what got me” moment with a clear findings list.

items.question: Is this Screen Time or an app blocker?
items.answer: No. Those cut access. HookLens labels addictive UI on screenshots so you can see the trap.

items.question: Do I need a browser extension?
items.answer: Not for this demo. Analyze runs in the browser. An extension may come later.

items.question: Where do reports live?
items.answer: In this browser’s local storage for the demo. Cloud share links are a later upgrade.

items.question: How is this different from dark-pattern detectors?
items.answer: Cousins only. Those hunt checkout tricks. HookLens focuses on habit machinery on feeds and social chrome.

cta.title: Try the workspace
cta.description: Mark two hooks and generate a report.
